source: wiki: Dungeons & Bosses + manual/bosses.json + Boss Recorder
_comment: Every boss. type = miniboss / boss / eventBoss (realm) or dungeon. location = where it spawns: biome / Realm / zone, or its dungeon. opens = dungeon portal it drops. icon = menu icon (a dungeon boss: the dungeon's). bossBarHash = Component#hashCode of its boss bar name (Boss Recorder). positions = spawn spots, tracker = Boss Tracker data (manual/bosses.json). tiers = T1-T8 equipment it drops (no chance on the wiki). drops: chance = percent per kill (fragments can be > 100); id = item id (dropped item model = <ns>:material/<id path>); rarity = item / companion rarity (the loot group); shiny = chance of the shiny version (id + -shiny); from = anyMob / specificMob / puzzle (not from the boss kill) or each (expanded from "All <rarity> Items"); kind only where it is not implied (id pet/ = pet, mount/ = mount, other id = item, no id: rarity = material, none = fragment). Dungeon boss names: manual/bosses.json ("???" = not written yet).
